scope: 36 existing findings and 16 external-review rows are cross-referenced, not counted as 52 unique factual defects.

issues.original_finding: Intro/index: only 14 operational headings covered
issues.resolution: Scope indexed as 14 operational families plus correlation; 15 navigation tags retained.
issues.original_evidence: Original heading; new taxonomy and incident register.

issues.original_finding: §1/§10: hypothesis “substantially true”; incidents “confirm” detectability
issues.resolution: Conditional hypothesis and conclusion replace population-level detectability claims.
issues.original_evidence: Study design contains no controlled detection evaluation or independent negative corpus.

issues.original_finding: §2/§5.9: High/Medium/Low stability, fidelity and FP risk
issues.resolution: Unmeasured FP/stability/fidelity rankings replaced by requirements and competing explanations.
issues.original_evidence: No measurement method, samples or uncertainty attached to the ratings.

issues.original_finding: §3: ATT&CK lifecycle; Kerberoasting under privilege escalation
issues.resolution: Nonsequential tactic mapping pinned to Enterprise ATT&CK v19.2; Kerberoasting under Credential Access.

issues.original_finding: §4.1: TEARDROP disguised as a JPEG
issues.resolution: TEARDROP executable distinguished from the input file with a likely fake JPEG header.

issues.original_finding: §4.1/§10: SUNBURST above-baseline entropy and assured DNS detection
issues.resolution: No SUNBURST entropy range, victim baseline or guaranteed entropy-detector success asserted.

issues.original_finding: §4.2/§8/§9: web-server child shells have near-zero legitimate prevalence
issues.resolution: Web-worker child shells are scoped hunting candidates with benign alternatives.
issues.original_evidence: [Microsoft Exchange post-exploitation analysis](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2021/03/25/analyzing-attacks-taking-advantage-of-the-exchange-server-vulnerabilities/). Hunting queries are not FP measurements.

issues.original_finding: §4.2: native IIS module activity attributed through original HAFNIUM source
issues.resolution: HAFNIUM separated from broader Exchange post-exploitation and later native-module claims.
issues.original_evidence: [Original HAFNIUM report](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2021/03/02/hafnium-targeting-exchange-servers/). Exact later-module attribution remains unverified here.

issues.original_finding: §4.3: one Conti narrative combines specific tools, proxy paths and timing from multiple reports
issues.resolution: Conti account anchored to one BazarCall/Trickbot investigation; unmatched proxy/timing details excluded.
issues.original_evidence: [BazarCall to Conti investigation](https://thedfirreport.com/2021/08/01/bazarcall-to-conti-ransomware-via-trickbot-and-cobalt-strike/). Unmatched specifics remain unverified.

issues.original_finding: §4.3/§9: AdFind causes every EDR to fire; workstation shadow-copy deletion is effectively never legitimate
issues.resolution: No universal EDR detection or near-zero legitimate snapshot-deletion claim.
issues.original_evidence: No prevalence dataset or cross-product experiment supplied by the article.

issues.original_finding: §4.4: DNSpionage folded into APT34/OilRig
issues.resolution: DNSpionage is not assigned to OilRig from the Talos report; RDAT mechanisms remain variant-specific.

issues.original_finding: §4.4: TXT:A ratio >1 abnormal for any legitimate service; no full QNAME means tunneling is undetectable
issues.resolution: No universal TXT:A threshold or assertion that missing QNAME defeats all possible detection.
issues.original_evidence: Analytical counterexamples; [Zeek DNS schema](https://docs.zeek.org/en/v8.2.1/reference/logs/dns.html). No universal threshold is established.

issues.original_finding: §4.8/§10: Volt Typhoon citation links to Midnight Blizzard; detection possible only with command-line logging
issues.resolution: Correct Volt Typhoon source; IFM on DC context and multiple evidence sources.

issues.original_finding: §4.9: MESSAGETAP is a shared library with a continuing 30-second configuration refresh
issues.resolution: MESSAGETAP described as ELF data miner; initial config loading/deletion distinguished from continuous refresh.

issues.original_finding: §4.11: secretsdump means DCSync; WMI 5861 associated with wmiexec
issues.resolution: Impacket tool/mode distinction; WMI subscription and RPC-port inference boundaries.
issues.original_evidence: [CISA AA22-277A](https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa22-277a); verify actual mode and protocol, not just tool or port.

issues.original_finding: §5.1: universal default Windows audit settings, including 4688
issues.resolution: Effective audit prerequisites replace blanket defaults; 4776 authority and 4648 corrected.

issues.original_finding: §5.2: `StartModule = "Unknown"` indicates shellcode
issues.resolution: Unresolved Sysmon start module is not shellcode proof.

issues.original_finding: §4/§5/§9: Sysmon 7 sees in-memory loaders; Sysmon command lines require Windows 4688 GPO
issues.resolution: Sysmon versus native 4688 configuration separated; manual-load coverage not guaranteed.

issues.original_finding: §5.4: `dns.log` has `TTL`; JA3/JA3S are baseline `ssl.log` fields
issues.resolution: Zeek TTLs corrected; fingerprint/package and analyzer prerequisites documented.

issues.original_finding: §5.3–5.6: exact vendor counts, dates, model inventories, alert labels and license dependencies
issues.resolution: Unverified vendor counts, dates, model inventories, hard-coded learning periods and licensing removed from operational guidance.
issues.original_evidence: Vendor notice is useful but does not validate individual product assertions. No independent product benchmark was run.

issues.original_finding: §5.5: every Entra risk detection is an anomaly model; MFA denial equals user-reported suspicious activity
issues.resolution: Risk signal classes and MFA failure versus user-reported fraud distinguished.

issues.original_finding: §5.5: exact Okta event identifiers
issues.resolution: Valid Okta event names retained; outcome interpretation qualified.
issues.original_evidence: [Okta event types](https://developer.okta.com/docs/reference/api/event-types/). No tenant behavior was tested.

issues.original_finding: §5.6: `GenerateDbAuthToken` as a CloudTrail API anomaly
issues.resolution: Both conflicting AWS documents cited; no token-generation CloudTrail detector is offered.

issues.original_finding: §5.7: entropy measures string randomness; short human labels establish a threshold
issues.resolution: Entropy defined as character-frequency statistic with length/alphabet bound; implementation tested.
issues.original_evidence: Mathematical counterexample in `tests/anomaly-research-logic.test.mjs`; no universal empirical DNS cutoff follows.

issues.original_finding: §6.1: all service tickets encrypted with NTLM hash; regular-user service-ticket requests abnormal
issues.resolution: RC4/AES service-key distinction, ordinary TGS requests and low-volume coverage limits.
issues.original_evidence: [MITRE Kerberoasting](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1558/003/); ticket encryption and legitimate workload must be checked locally.

issues.original_finding: §6.2: SACL grants SYSTEM audit rights; all machine accounts excluded
issues.resolution: SACL auditing versus permission explained; blanket account-name exclusions removed.

issues.original_finding: §6.2/§8: DCSync query outputs `IpAddress` from 4662, requires both GUIDs in one event, omits stated access-mask check
issues.resolution: DCSync access bit, separate rights, same-DC bounded logon correlation and unresolved/ambiguous output tested.

issues.original_finding: §6.3: PtH sends the NTLM hash directly; S-1-0-0 proves no interactive source logon
issues.resolution: NTLM challenge-response distinguished from directly sending hash; null SID not source-session proof.

issues.original_finding: §6.4/§8: unknown call trace proves injection; trusted image-path allowlist proves benign
issues.resolution: Unresolved call trace and trusted filenames/paths are not malicious/benign verdicts.
issues.original_evidence: Inference boundary; Sysmon fields do not certify intent.

issues.original_finding: §8: preserved query exports split tokens/operators; undeclared `THRESHOLD` / server-list placeholders
issues.resolution: Broken legacy blocks archived; eight single-source normalized-schema KQL examples execute in a real Kusto engine.
issues.original_evidence: Static inspection: split `15`/`m`, `0`/`x17`, `!`/`in`, and comparison operators. This was not a query-engine compiler test.

issues.original_finding: §8 password spray: time-range expression used as join key, tenant-wide aggregation loses affected identity
issues.resolution: Password-spray equality keys, attempted-account membership and time ordering tested.

issues.original_finding: §8: result 50140 treated as success; all nonzero codes treated as bad passwords
issues.resolution: Result 0 success; 50126 selected invalid-credential class; 50140 and policy errors excluded.

issues.original_finding: §8 bulk download: calendar-day baseline vs rolling 24 hours; inner join; positive stdev filter
issues.resolution: Calendar-day alignment, completeness, cold starts, zero MAD and future exclusion tested.
issues.original_evidence: Static query logic and synthetic cold-start/zero-variance counterexamples.

issues.original_finding: §8 hybrid gating: precision improves without losing recall
issues.resolution: No free precision/recall improvement promised; synthetic gate ablation exposes lost positives.
issues.original_evidence: Set-intersection counterexample in the logic tests.

issues.original_finding: §9/§10: no single anomaly should cause investigation; other sections call single events near-deterministic
issues.resolution: Investigation, incident declaration and containment separated; no blanket single-signal suppression.

issues.original_finding: §10: Midnight Blizzard defeats per-tenant analytics; SaaS-native theft creates no signals without SaaS audit
issues.resolution: Tenant-local and SaaS visibility limitations qualified; no universal absence claim.

issues.resolution: Already removed before this revision; now cited accurately to the March update with its limited scope.

issues.original_finding: Midnight Blizzard permission
issues.resolution: Already corrected before this revision; full_access_as_app retained explicitly.

issues.resolution: Acquired key/forged tokens preserved; CSRB customer detection and Big Yellow Taxi added without inventing a private rule.

issues.original_finding: Storm-1283 citation
issues.resolution: December 12, 2023 Microsoft report retained; distinct campaign from Storm-0558.

issues.original_finding: Volt Typhoon IFM execution host
issues.resolution: DC execution versus remote initiation distinguished; non-DC-only detector not offered.

issues.resolution: Eventlog System 104 distinguished from Security 1102; actual cleared channel required.

issues.resolution: Audit Logon membership documented; effective-policy verification replaces universal defaults.

issues.original_finding: Defender native events
issues.resolution: Operational 5001/5007 included; configuration change not automatically malicious.

issues.original_finding: Conti merged tools/timeline
issues.resolution: Single-investigation account; IcedID detail not attributed to BazarCall/Trickbot case.

issues.resolution: March 22 behavioral detections precede disclosure; icon-based C2 information distinguished from executable download.

issues.original_finding: MOVEit account and Windows 4720
issues.resolution: Already corrected before revision; application-database operation retained explicitly.

issues.original_finding: RC4-only Kerberoasting
issues.resolution: AES-inclusive request-breadth view, krbtgt exclusion and measured low-volume miss.

issues.original_finding: PtH source-side view
issues.resolution: Type 9/seclogo included as non-universal, non-exclusive hunting view.

issues.original_finding: JA3/JA4 currency
issues.resolution: TLS-extension-order issue and implementation dependency documented; fingerprint is not attribution.

issues.original_finding: TF-IDF and model assumptions
issues.resolution: Feature weighting separated from clustering; count dispersion and zero-MAD caveats; synthetic comparison.

issues.original_finding: Inconsistent examples
issues.resolution: Aligned download windows/units, server peers, SSH ancestry, point/context distinctions and service-principal flow example corrected.

issues.original_finding: Unsupported victim counts, NSA rare-URI cutoff and exact Conti timing
issues.resolution: Unsupported numeric claims are not retained as established incident facts.

issues.original_finding: MOVEit configuration-file claim and named UNC3944 victim attribution
issues.resolution: Use documented database settings and source-scoped cluster account; do not carry unmatched filename/victim assertions forward.

issues.original_finding: APT41 SQLULDR2/PINEGROVE and Unit 42 title/URL mismatch
issues.resolution: Direct July 2024 APT41 report and specific RDAT investigation replace generic/mismatched sources.

issues.original_finding: Historical infographics can contradict corrected prose
issues.resolution: All 44 original media references, including the old cover, are retained in the superseded historical appendix. A separate set of 55 reviewed, source-linked inline figures replaces their instructional role: 45 unchanged user-supplied PNG/JPEG illustrations and 10 generated diagrams. Uploads have explanatory captions and text equivalents; incident figures distinguish source reporting from hypotheses and disclose source-access limits. Detection-source figures distinguish documented capabilities from verified local collection. Register counts, synthetic DNS/SaaS arithmetic and credential access-mask decompositions are checked, and numerical study figures use versioned evidence. The old raster illustrations remain unvalidated; replacement does not certify their contents.

issues.original_finding: Production ingestion/thresholds/accuracy
issues.resolution: Normalized-schema functional tests and public lab replay do not establish live Sentinel/Splunk ingestion, production precision, recall or containment safety.

issues.original_finding: Medium edition synchronization
issues.resolution: Prepared correction notice; no Medium modification or synchronization claimed.

issues.original_finding: Independent factual certification
issues.resolution: This is a source-grounded author/assistant revision and reproducible test package, not an independent peer-review certification or 100-percent factual guarantee.
